items.article: Prudential Financial's Retirement Pulse survey shows retirees fear spending savings and prefer guaranteed income to avoid financial insecurity. Millions of Americans save for decades for the day when they turn in their laptops and never have to work again. When the day comes, though, many fear spending down their nest eggs . Prudential Financial's 2026 Retirement Pulse survey , conducted online between July and August, found that only 14% of respondents felt comfortable spending each month in retirement for enjoyment, such as hobbies, travel, and dining out. Anxiety about spending doesn't go away among higher-net-worth individuals, as 39% of those with over $500,000 in investable assets felt comfortable spending for enjoyment. As Prudential notes, it's a case of FORO, or Fear of Running Out . M&S, Sainsbury’s and Waitrose are amongst a host of British supermarkets that have already opened Christmas bookings. For those who want to plan their festive feasts last-minute, however, both Iceland and Co-Op open bookings just days before Christmas Eve. items.article: Neuralink director Shivon Zilis is the mother of four of Elon Musk's children and an ex-OpenAI board member. Learn more about the Canadian-born VC. Shivon Zilis — a longtime executive at Elon Musk's companies and the mother of four of his children — said her relationship with the billionaire ended "in a week with no warning." In a post on X, Zilis shared a rare glimpse into Musk's romantic life. "I feel happy that I got to show Elon how it feels to be deeply understood, nurtured, and peacefully loved with stability and gentleness," she wrote on Friday. "My heart is full knowing I got to do that, and I hope it leaves a lasting good effect." Zilis and her employer, the Musk-owned Neuralink , didn't respond to a request for comment from Business Insider. Musk also didn't respond. She joined Musk at OpenAI in 2016, a year after its founding, and helped helm the company during Musk's investment and his rancorous 2018 split with CEO Sam Altman. From there, Zilis followed Musk to Tesla and his rival project, xAI.
